notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for timestamped directed-interaction retraction fan-out. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, logical-time implementation, and callback configuration. It verifies one retraction suppresses queued directed-interaction copies at two constrained recipients, independent recipient grants remain clean, a later directed message is delivered to both recipients with standard metadata, and the delivered handle reaches the standard MessageCanNoLongerBeRetracted boundary without stale retraction callbacks. It does not assert provider-specific callback timing, MOM reports, DDM, save/restore, or interoperability.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador sendDirectedInteraction, retract, timeAdvanceRequest, enableTimeRegulation, enableTimeConstrained with FederateAmbassador receiveDirectedInteraction and timeAdvanceGrant callbacks
